zomboid-wilderness-mod.EnableSleepShelte: Enabling this makes it so players cannot sleep in pre-made buildings or vehicles. They will have to sleep on the ground outside, in a tent, or in a player-built structure.
zomboid-wilderness-mod.StartingItemsPres: Vanilla leaves traditional game settings intact. Wilderness Glamper starts off with tent, sleeping bag and other small comforts. Stranded Hiker starts with the barest essentials. Naked and Afraid starts with absolutely nothing—good luck!
